cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've brought a blanket. Your heater's still broken? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm managing. Leave the blanket, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Gladly. Would you say you needed my help?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need the blanket. I can reset the heater myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. The fuse box is in my locked cupboard. Shall I wait while you manage?

heightening.evidence: A5 increases leverage through a new lock rather than adapting A help to B terms.
